Both packages passed visible release smoke; the 1.0.1 lab ZIP is 112638856 bytes with SHA-256 af368bb7c9f67ef0e5523521019939dca2844a6e3397ecefa8014bad9b6b2b99. A two-version Catalog admitted 1.0.0 and newest 1.0.1, Version Self-test returned Verified=True, and a managed root was seeded from the real 1.0.0 package. Formal 1.0.1 must still be regenerated from the published v1.0.0 tag.
